question: Using a recursive monthly inventory adjustment model starting from December 2018 inventory levels, where we restock a product if its ending inventory drops below the minimum required level, determine for each product the month in 2019 where the absolute difference between its ending inventory and the minimum required level is the smallest, and return the product_id, that month, and the absolute difference.
sql:
WITH RECURSIVE months AS (
    SELECT DATE '2019-01-01' AS mth
    UNION ALL
    SELECT mth + INTERVAL '1' MONTH
    FROM months
    WHERE mth < DATE '2019-12-01'
),
products AS (
    SELECT product_id, qty_minimum, qty_purchase
    FROM product_minimums
),
start_inv AS (
    SELECT product_id, qty AS starting_qty
    FROM inventory_totals
    WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM product_minimums)
),
inv_model AS (
    SELECT 
        p.product_id,
        m.mth,
        s.starting_qty AS beginning_inv,
        COALESCE(mb.qty, 0) AS demand,
        p.qty_minimum,
        p.qty_purchase,
        s.starting_qty - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0) AS pre_restock_inv,
        CASE WHEN s.starting_qty - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0) < p.qty_minimum 
             THEN s.starting_qty - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0) + p.qty_purchase
             ELSE s.starting_qty - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0)
        END AS ending_inv
    FROM products p
    CROSS JOIN months m
    JOIN start_inv s ON s.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN monthly_budget mb ON mb.product_id = p.product_id AND mb.mth = m.mth
    WHERE m.mth = DATE '2019-01-01'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        im.product_id,
        m.mth,
        im.ending_inv AS beginning_inv,
        COALESCE(mb.qty, 0) AS demand,
        p.qty_minimum,
        p.qty_purchase,
        im.ending_inv - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0) AS pre_restock_inv,
        CASE WHEN im.ending_inv - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0) < p.qty_minimum 
             THEN im.ending_inv - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0) + p.qty_purchase
             ELSE im.ending_inv - COALESCE(mb.qty, 0)
        END AS ending_inv
    FROM inv_model im
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = im.product_id
    JOIN months m ON m.mth = im.mth + INTERVAL '1' MONTH
    LEFT JOIN monthly_budget mb ON mb.product_id = im.product_id AND mb.mth = m.mth
    WHERE m.mth <= DATE '2019-12-01'
),
with_diff AS (
    SELECT product_id, mth, ending_inv, qty_minimum,
           ABS(ending_inv - qty_minimum) AS abs_diff
    FROM inv_model
)
SELECT product_id, mth, abs_diff
FROM with_diff
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY abs_diff ASC, mth ASC) = 1
ORDER BY product_id
